name: backlog-artifact
description: Publishes a Backlog.md backlog as a phone-friendly claude.ai Artifact, refreshed automatically after turns that change it.

auto_publish.title: Publish automatically
auto_publish.description: After a turn that changed the backlog, ask Claude to publish the page. Off: the page is only rendered locally; publish with /backlog-artifact:publish.

publish_interval_minutes.title: Minimum minutes between publishes
publish_interval_minutes.description: Changes made sooner than this after the last publish wait for a later turn. Each publish costs one extra Claude step over the session's context. 0 publishes after every changed turn.

include_drafts.title: Include drafts
include_drafts.description: Show tasks from backlog/drafts as a Draft state.

include_archived.title: Include archived tasks
include_archived.description: Show tasks from backlog/archive/tasks as an Archived state.
